Whether elegant hunters or grim scavengers, each raptor plays its part in the Race of Life, adapting to stay one step ahead.

DC, a dominant croc, faces challenges at each hunting zone—from shallow waters to rocky crossings. He battles rivals, adapts his strategy, and learns to thrive in changing conditions. As the rivers dry and herds thin, DC makes one final kill. The Mara and Grumeti demand unique skills, turning quiet waters into deadly Predator Zones.

programme.title: Tueurs d'élite

Als die 27-jährige Barbara Carr in ihrem Haus brutal ermordet wird, erzählt ihr Mann der Polizei, dass Fremde bei ihm eingebrochen sind, ihn gefesselt und seine Frau getötet haben. programme.title: Court Cam - Auf der Anklagebank
programme.desc: Ein Jahr nachdem Lori Phillips die gefrorene Leiche ihres Mannes in der Einfahrt gefunden hat, wird sie wegen fahrlässiger Tötung zweiten Grades angeklagt. Die Staatsanwaltschaft wirft ihr vor, Mark Phillips überfahren und den Vorfall vertuscht zu haben. Lori drohen bis zu 25 Jahre Haft. Deshalb hat sie sich entschieden, selbst auszusagen. Sie will die Geschworenen davon überzeugen, dass sie vor einem gewalttätigen Mann geflohen ist. Ob ihre Schilderungen von Angst und Missbrauch die Jury überzeugen werden, bleibt offen.

programme.title: Vermisst und ermordet
programme.desc: Die wohlhabende Witwe Evelyn Lund erlag dem Charme von Robert Lund, einem geschiedenen Baumchirurgen. Ihre drei Töchter missbilligten die Verbindung, weil sie dachten, er sei nur an ihrem Geld interessiert. Evelyns Familie ist schockiert, als sie erfährt, dass Evelyn und Robert beschlossen haben, von Lancashire nach Frankreich zu ziehen. Am 29. Dezember 1999 verließ Evelyn Lund das Haus eines Freundes - und verschwand. Erst drei Tage später meldete Robert Lund sie auf Drängen von Evelyns Töchtern bei der französischen Polizei als vermisst. Knapp zwei Jahre später wurde ihre Leiche gefunden.

programme.title: Vermisst und ermordet
programme.desc: Janet Müller war eine deutsche Austauschstudentin, die an der Universität Brighton studierte. Im März 2015 wurde sie in das Mill View Krankenhaus in Hove eingeliefert, nachdem sie von der Polizei an einer Bushaltestelle in ihrer Nachtkleidung gefunden worden war. 10 Tage später kletterte sie über eine Mauer, um aus dem Krankenhaus zu entkommen. Nur einen Tag später wird aus dem Vermisstenfall ein Mord. Janets Leiche wird verbrannt im Kofferraum eines Autos auf einem Feld gefunden. Christopher Jeffrey-Shaw gab zu, das Auto angezündet zu haben, bestritt jedoch den Mord.

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives - Die DNA der Täter
programme.desc: 1983 wird die kleine Gemeinde Seabrook in Texas erschüttert, als die 20-jährige Kellnerin Susan Eads nach einer Nacht mit ihren Freunden tot aufgefunden wird. Susans Freunde berichten den Behörden, dass sie eine zwielichtige Gestalt gesehen haben, die Susan aus der Bar gefolgt ist. Doch 1983 fällt es den Ermittlern schwer, einen Verdächtigen für den Mord an Susan zu finden. Können 34 Jahre später die Fortschritte in der forensischen Technologie helfen, den mysteriösen Stalker und möglicherweise Susans Mörder zu identifizieren?

programme.title: Mord - Von der Tat bis in die Zelle

programme.title: Crime in Progress - Verbrechen in Echtzeit
programme.desc: Eine ganz normale Postzustellrunde nimmt eine tödliche Wendung, als ein beliebter Postbote am helllichten Tag ermordet wird. Während die Bodycams laufen, versuchen Polizei und Bundesbeamte mit Hochdruck, die Wahrheit aufzudecken. Was sie herausfinden, führt zu schockierenden Festnahmen, die die gesamte Gemeinde fassungslos machen.

programme.title: The First 48 - Momente der Entscheidung

programme.title: Vermisst und ermordet
programme.desc: Die 22-jährige Helen McCourt war auf dem Heimweg von der Arbeit in Liverpool, bevor sie am Abend mit ihrem neuen Freund ausgehen wollte. Sie stieg nur 500 Meter von ihrem Haus entfernt aus dem Bus und war verschwunden. Als sie nicht nach Hause kam, dachte ihre Familie zunächst, dass sie sich wegen eines wetterbedingten Zwischenfalls verspätet hätte. Doch nachdem sie sich bei Freunden und Verwandten erkundigt hatten, verständigten Helens Eltern die Polizei, die sich auf die Suche nach Helen machte.

programme.title: Vermisst und ermordet
programme.desc: Im Dezember 1988 hatte Lorraine Benson mit ihrem Freund Peter verabredet, dass er sie von der U-Bahn-Station abholen sollten. Als er nicht kam, beschloss Lorraine, sich zu Fuß auf den Weg zu machen. Um 01:20 Uhr am nächsten Morgen erhielten Lorraines Eltern einen Anruf von Peters Mutter, die ihnen mitteilte, dass Lorraine nicht angekommen war. Man war sofort um Lorraines Sicherheit besorgt, da in letzter Zeit mehrere Frauen in der Gegend überfallen worden waren, und so begann Lorraines Vater zusammen mit der Polizei nach ihr zu suchen. Etwa zwölf Stunden später wurde Lorraines Leiche gefunden.

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives - Die DNA der Täter
programme.desc: Im Jahr 1994 wird Okaloosa County erschüttert, als die skelettierten Überreste einer Frau am Straßenrand gefunden werden. Die Entdeckung löst eine Suche nach Antworten aus, die fast zwanzig Jahre andauern wird. programme.title: Court Cam - Auf der Anklagebank
programme.desc: Der Parodontologe Charlie Adelson aus Florida soll zwei Auftragskiller angeheuert haben, um seinen ehemaligen Schwager Dan Markel töten zu lassen. Damit wollte er angeblich seine Schwester aus einem eskalierenden Sorgerechtsstreit befreien. Adelson bestreitet das. Er sagt, die Täter hätten ihn selbst erpresst und er habe aus Angst gezahlt. Nun muss die Jury entscheiden, ob sie ihm glaubt - oder ob sie überzeugt ist, dass er den Mord in Auftrag gegeben hat.

programme.title: Vermisst und ermordet
programme.desc: Die 22-jährige Helen McCourt war auf dem Heimweg von der Arbeit in Liverpool, bevor sie am Abend mit ihrem neuen Freund ausgehen wollte. Sie stieg nur 500 Meter von ihrem Haus entfernt aus dem Bus und war verschwunden. Als sie nicht nach Hause kam, dachte ihre Familie zunächst, dass sie sich wegen eines wetterbedingten Zwischenfalls verspätet hätte. Doch nachdem sie sich bei Freunden und Verwandten erkundigt hatten, verständigten Helens Eltern die Polizei, die sich auf die Suche nach Helen machte.

programme.title: Vermisst und ermordet
programme.desc: Im Dezember 1988 hatte Lorraine Benson mit ihrem Freund Peter verabredet, dass er sie von der U-Bahn-Station abholen sollten. Als er nicht kam, beschloss Lorraine, sich zu Fuß auf den Weg zu machen. Um 01:20 Uhr am nächsten Morgen erhielten Lorraines Eltern einen Anruf von Peters Mutter, die ihnen mitteilte, dass Lorraine nicht angekommen war. Man war sofort um Lorraines Sicherheit besorgt, da in letzter Zeit mehrere Frauen in der Gegend überfallen worden waren, und so begann Lorraines Vater zusammen mit der Polizei nach ihr zu suchen. Etwa zwölf Stunden später wurde Lorraines Leiche gefunden.

programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi

Duder arbeitet mit einer befreundeten Hundestaffel-Einheit zusammen, um einen Verdächtigen so festzunehmen, dass er keine Fluchtmöglichkeit mehr hat. Chase macht seinem Namen alle Ehre. programme.title: K9 - Die Hundestaffel mit Jim Belushi
programme.desc: Wenn Polizisten eine finale Warnung aussprechen, ist das die letzte Chance, sich zu ergeben - entweder kapitulieren oder dem Hund entgegentreten. "Scout" stößt frontal mit einem bewaffneten Verdächtigen zusammen, der sich weigert, zurückzuweichen, und der Polizeihund "Vlad" stellt sich einem trotzigen Fahrer entgegen, der den Anweisungen nicht Folge leistet. Mitten in der Nacht spürt "Edge" zwei flüchtende mutmaßliche Diebe auf und bringt sie zur Strecke, während "ZAM" methodisch eine Fahrzeugdurchsuchung durchführt und dabei eine ganze Reihe von Anklagepunkten aufdeckt.

programme.title: The First 48 - Momente der Entscheidung
programme.desc: Diese Episode greift drei Fälle aus dem Archiv von "The First 48" auf, in denen Streitigkeiten zu Gewalt eskalierten und schließlich in einem Mord endeten. Zunächst werden bei einem rachsüchtigen Amoklauf in Tulsa zwei Menschen getötet. Dann mischt sich eine junge Mutter in Dallas in einen Familienstreit ein und bezahlt dafür mit ihrem Leben. Schließlich besucht ein Mann aus Tulsa seine Ex-Freundin und kommt dabei ums Leben.

programme.title: Vermisst und ermordet
programme.desc: Natalie, eine junge Mutter dreier Kinder, wurde von ihrem Freund Paul Hemming zu Hause getötet, während ihre drei Kinder oben schliefen. In den Jahren vor Natalies Tod gab es sowohl Vorfälle von Zwangskontrolle als auch von gewalttätigem Verhalten. 2016 war Natalie endlich bereit, Paul zu verlassen. Nachdem ihre Mutter sie als vermisst gemeldet hatte, tischte Paul der Polizei eine abenteuerliche Geschichte auf. Doch ihr sechsjähriger Sohn wurde Zeuge, wie Natalies Leiche im Wohnzimmer in einen Teppich eingewickelt wurde, und aufgrund seiner Aussage wurde Paul angeklagt.

programme.title: Vermisst und ermordet
programme.desc: Am 5. Juni 1998 verabschiedete sich der elfjährige Wesley von seiner Mutter und fuhr mit dem Fahrrad zum örtlichen Laden, um Süßigkeiten zu kaufen. Liz meldete ihn bei der Polizei als vermisst, als er nicht nach Hause zurückkehrte. Trotz Wesleys Verwundbarkeit (er litt an Epilepsie) hielt die Polizei ihn zunächst für einen Ausreißer und verschwendete damit nach Ansicht der Familie wertvolle Zeit. Stattdessen organisierte die Gemeinde Suchteams für ihn. Es dauerte drei Wochen, bis die Polizei auf den einschlägig vorbestraften Dominic McKilligan aufmerksam wurde.

programme.title: Wanted - Flucht nach Mexiko
programme.desc: Die Fugitive Hunters sind einem Amerikaner auf der Spur, der nach einer Schießerei in Phoenix auf der Flucht ist. Außerdem gehen Agenten auf die Jagd nach einem Bandenmitglied, das in Südkalifornien wegen Mordes gesucht wird und sich seit fast vier Jahren in Mexiko versteckt hält.

programme.title: Wanted - Flucht nach Mexiko
programme.desc: Ein amerikanischer Teenager, der in Chicago wegen Mordes gesucht wird, glaubt, dass er in Tijuana vor der Justiz sicher ist. In der Zwischenzeit spüren die Agenten einen Mann aus Nevada auf, der Frauen und Mädchen sexuell belästigt hat. Das Team ist entschlossen, einen verurteilten Drogenhändler zu fassen, der ihnen schon einmal entwischt ist.

programme.title: Taskforce Kinderschutz - Verbrechen im Netz
programme.desc: Das Verlangen eines durchschnittlichen amerikanischen Vaters nach Sex mit einer 14-Jährigen führt zu einer Verhaftung, die sein abartiges Doppelleben offenlegt. Anschließend entlarven gruselige Social-Media-Nachrichten an eine Schülerin einen gefährlichen Sexualstraftäter. Ein Polizist fungiert als Köder, um einen Sexualstraftäter in die Falle zu locken.

programme.title: Taskforce Kinderschutz - Verbrechen im Netz
programme.desc: Als ein Mann in einer Chat-App eine 13-Jährige ins Visier nimmt, macht sich Detective Tony Godwin auf die Jagd, um ihn zu fassen, bevor es zu spät ist. Dann führt ein Hinweis zur Aufdeckung der riesigen Sammlung von Material über sexuellen Kindesmissbrauch eines Täters. Eine Online-Anzeige löst eine gewagte verdeckte Ermittlungsaktion aus.

programme.title: The First 48 - Momente der Entscheidung
programme.desc: Diese Episode greift drei Fälle aus dem Archiv von "The First 48" auf, in denen Streitigkeiten zu Gewalt eskalierten und schließlich in einem Mord endeten. Zunächst werden bei einem rachsüchtigen Amoklauf in Tulsa zwei Menschen getötet. Dann mischt sich eine junge Mutter in Dallas in einen Familienstreit ein und bezahlt dafür mit ihrem Leben. Schließlich besucht ein Mann aus Tulsa seine Ex-Freundin und kommt dabei ums Leben.

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives - Die DNA der Täter
programme.desc: Als 1986 eine junge Mutter in Green Bay, Michigan, brutal ermordet wird, sind ihre Familie und die ganze Gemeinde von Trauer geplagt. Obwohl sie alle Beweise haben, verfügen die Ermittler in den 80er Jahren nicht über die Mittel, um den Fall zu lösen. Können moderne Ermittler fast 40 Jahre später eine neue forensische Wissenschaft nutzen, um einen Durchbruch in dem Fall zu erzielen?

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives - Die DNA der Täter
programme.desc: Im Mai 1987 wird die Kleinstadt Lexington in North Carolina von einer Tragödie heimgesucht, als die 29-jährige Mary Davis, Mutter von zwei Kindern, ermordet aufgefunden wird. Obwohl die Ermittler eine Vielzahl von Beweisen sammeln und Verdächtige befragen, kommen sie mit den Ermittlungen nicht weiter und die Identität des Mörders bleibt ein Rätsel. Können moderne Ermittler, ausgestattet mit moderner Forensik, Jahrzehnte später Marys Mörder entlarven?

programme.title: Court Cam - Auf der Anklagebank
programme.desc: Die 23-jährige Sasha Skare steht wegen Mordes an ihrem Musikproduzenten und Liebhaber Martell DeRouen vor Gericht. Sie hat einen Vergleich abgelehnt und beschlossen, vor Gericht auszusagen, um ihre Seite der Geschichte zu erzählen - dass sie missbraucht wurde und die Schüsse unbeabsichtigt waren. Wird sich ihr Risiko auszahlen oder wird sie den Rest ihres Lebens im Gefängnis verbringen?

programme.desc: Ein amerikanischer Teenager, der in Chicago wegen Mordes gesucht wird, glaubt, dass er in Tijuana vor der Justiz sicher ist. In der Zwischenzeit spüren die Agenten einen Mann aus Nevada auf, der Frauen und Mädchen sexuell belästigt hat. Das Team ist entschlossen, einen verurteilten Drogenhändler zu fassen, der ihnen schon einmal entwischt ist.

programme.title: Bloodline Detectives - Die DNA der Täter
programme.desc: Als 1986 eine junge Mutter in Green Bay, Michigan, brutal ermordet wird, sind ihre Familie und die ganze Gemeinde von Trauer geplagt. Obwohl sie alle Beweise haben, verfügen die Ermittler in den 80er Jahren nicht über die Mittel, um den Fall zu lösen. Können moderne Ermittler fast 40 Jahre später eine neue forensische Wissenschaft nutzen, um einen Durchbruch in dem Fall zu erzielen?

programme.title: Hans Zimmer
programme.desc: Hans Zimmer is one of the most successful film music composers working today. His multi-award winning career reaches back to the mid-eighties and he has developed close working relationships with renowned directors such as Ridley Scott, Tony Scott, Michael Bay, Ron Howard, Gore Verbinski and Christopher Nolan. His credits include some of the biggest blockbuster movies and most acclaimed TV series of all time. This concert was filmed on 7th May 2016 in Prague during Hans Zimmer's hugely successful European concert tour. Hans was accompanied by a band, orchestra and choir, 72 musicians in total, including guest guitarist Johnny Marr. The staging was spectacular with a ground breaking light show, stunning visuals and a state of the art sound system. With Hans Zimmer performing on multiple instruments and giving introductory insights to many of the pieces, this show is a treat for lovers of both great music and great movies.

programme.title: Diana Krall
programme.desc: Diana Krall has had a long time fascination with bossa nova, a type of music which perfectly suits her sophisticated yet sensual style. This culminated in her new studio album 'Quiet Nights' (released by Verve in spring 2009) and in this stunning concert filmed in the home of the bossa nova, Rio de Janeiro, in November 2008. Accompanied by her band and an orchestra, Diana Krall delivers a superb live performance of standards in true bossa nova style but clearly bearing her unique stamp. This concert captures Diana Krall at her scintillating best.

programme.title: Ocean Vet

programme.title: Ocean Vet
programme.desc: Follow the team as they capture and release wild green sea turtles in a bid to study their health and populations before fitting a satellite tag to a mature specimen that will collect vital data on it's oceanic migrations.

programme.title: Ocean Vet

programme.title: Gdansk

programme.title: Iceland
programme.desc: Majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, raging waterfalls, threatening fjords, mighty glaciers, endless lava fields – there is hardly another country in the world that offers as much impressive nature as Iceland, the remote island in the harsh North Sea. The nature in Iceland is immense! Here, the four elements of nature can be experienced as raw and as close-up as practically no other place on Earth. And nowhere on the northern hemisphere can the origin of life, can growth and decay be experienced as dramatically as here. Besides the impressive nature, we get to know the dramatic history of the Viking culture with its nature-influenced mythology and discuss the negative effects of excessive tourism.

programme.title: Chasing Monsters: El Nino

programme.title: A Simple Path

programme.desc: In a land celebrated for its lakes, forests, and polar bears, Canada is hit hard by climate disasters. programme.title: EXPELLED FROM THE TOP A STORY OF TIBETAN REFUGEES

programme.title: KARGIL 1999 THE UNTOLD STORY OF THE INDIAN AIR FORCE

programme.desc: Jack meets people with synaesthesia and experiences multisensory gastronomy.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Pain & Fear"

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S1 - "Creativity"
programme.desc: Jack meets a man with Sudden Artistic Output syndrome and unleashes his creativity.

programme.title: Extremes S1 - "Largest Animals, Human Bodies and Football"
programme.desc: In this episode of Extremes, we will be exploring the largest animals, extreme facts about the human body and record breaking extremes in football and the field of music.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "MMA - Nick Hein"
programme.desc: Nick Hein is a professional Mixed Martial Artist from Cologne and signed with the UFC. His ultimate goal is to become MMA world champion.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "Extreme Martial Arts – Shaina West"
programme.desc: Shaina West taught herself martial arts by watching Youtube recovering from a motorcycle accident. The videos she posted went viral and ‘The Samurider’ was born.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "Karate – James Pankiewicz"
programme.desc: Englishman and karateka James Pankiewicz came to Okinawa, the birthplace of Karate, for his wife and to open a Dojo and the immensely popular Dojo Bar.

programme.title: Power & S3 - "Bokator – Tharot Sam"
programme.desc: Tharoth Sam, 26, is the first female fighter in Cambodian Bokator. She is also an MMA fighter and became a movie star starring in the big screen blockbuster, Jailbreak.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "Paris & Barcelona"
programme.desc: Bones introduce his trademark trickery to people in Paris and Barcelona, performing mind reading and an attempt to escape a straitjacket while breakdancing.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "London"
programme.desc: In this episode Bones is back in his home city, London where he stuns locals with his mind reading, card trickery and disappearing skills.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "South Korea - Night"
programme.desc: Bones is in Seoul, South Korea. He explores the city by night and performs a mixture of magic tricks, including a vanishing trick, coin tricks and card tricks.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "South Korea - Traditional"
programme.desc: In this episode Bones is in South Korea, where he visits Taekwondo group, the K Tigers, a tarot card reader and reveals the secret to the perfect card shuffle.

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S5 - "Garage Science"
programme.desc: Host Steve Spangler and his sidekick Higginsworth explore science experiments you can do in your own garage.

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S5 - "Art Science"
programme.desc: Host Steve Spangler and his sidekick Higginsworth explore new ways to create art, using science.

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S5 - "Classroom: Impossible"
programme.desc: Fourth grade teacher Sandra Sanchez has a problem – her class is a year behind in science after a season of virtual-only teaching.

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S5 - "Museum Of Science, Boston #1"
programme.desc: Host Steve Spangler and his sidekick Higginsworth explore the Museum of Science, Boston, for new do-it-yourself science tricks and experiments.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Tokyo"
programme.desc: Experts strip away Tokyo to show the seismic engineering, massive storm drains, and advanced shock absorbers keeping this earthquake-prone city safe.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "New Orleans"
programme.desc: The defenses of New Orleans are stripped back to expose the massive pumps, levees, and wetlands engineered to hold back Mississippi and Gulf storms.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Hyabusa2"
programme.desc: The Japanese Asteroid sample return mission has reached its target and is surveying the space rock ready to dip down and take a sample. The return of asteroid material to Earth will aid scientists in the evolving asteroid planetary defense systems.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Eyes to the Heavens"
programme.desc: Two new space telescopes are in orbit and completing their shakedown; Gaia and TESS they too will be joined by the James Webb Telescope. Together they will be opening up a whole new vista into time and space.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Martian Attractions"
programme.desc: The Latest in Martian exploration from orbit and on the ground, new sources of water and planetary dust storms are a few of the stories unfolding on to the Red Planet.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Cubesat"
programme.desc: Cubesats the tiny Satellites are growing in main stream popularity, they have even been sent to Mars with the Insight Mission.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "The Animal Kingdom Meets Future Tech"
programme.desc: Host Chuck Pell goes to abandoned areas of Detroit where dog lovers are tracking thousands of strays… with drones.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "The Future Of Learning"
programme.desc: Host Chuck Pell shows us a place that’s taking a hands-on approach to learning with robotic creatures.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "Transforming How Things Are Made"
programme.desc: Host Chuck Pell will see how industrial diamonds are transforming manufacturing.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Mars"
programme.desc: Beneath the red dust, CGI peels away Martian volcanoes and ice to reveal a once-Earth-like world and the challenges of future human missions.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "The Sun"
programme.desc: By stripping away the Sun's boiling plasma layers, this CGI study reveals the nuclear core that fuels our world while tracking lethal solar storms.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Fun with the Sun"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at NASA’s next mission to send a spacecraft that will “touch” the sun.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Space Firsts"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli interviews several pioneers of space and discovers the determination and courage required to become the “first”.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Teaming up with NASA"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli visits the Sierra Nevada Corporation, which is building a spacecraft that can deliver cargo to and from the International Space Station.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S4 - "Students of Space"
programme.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli looks at students who are becoming involved with space exploration.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Proving Einstein"

programme.desc: Could dinosaurs still walk the Earth? Deep in the Congo, legends say yes. In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green investigates the chilling reports of Mokele-mbembe, a dinosaur-like creature said to inhabit the remote swamps of the Congo Basin. We dive into real expedition footage, indigenous stories, and eyewitness accounts that all point to one shocking possibility: something ancient may still be alive in the heart of Africa. From early missionary reports in the 1900s to modern explorers risking their lives to chase the unknown, we piece together the long-standing mystery surrounding alleged dinosaur sightings in Africa. Whether you're into cryptids, paleontology, or just love a good wilderness mystery, this episode will have you questioning what’s really hiding in the unexplored corners of the Earth.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In 2003, Brett Mann and two friends were stranded in the flooded wilds of northern Australia. When Brett swam for help, he was taken by a massive crocodile. But the true horror came next. For nearly 24 hours, the crocodile returned—again and again—carrying Brett’s body, circling the tree where his friends clung to life. It wasn’t just hunting. It was showing them something. Was this predator defending its territory? Sending a message? Or acting with something more than instinct? - In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we examine the terrifying true story of Brett Mann—and ask: - When nature strikes back… is it ever personal?

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles

From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles

programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew heads to Colorado to field test Winchester’s new Supreme Long Range ammunition—engineered for hunters who demand precision at extended distances. Featuring the BC Max bullet, built with a high ballistic coefficient, heat-resistant tip, and match-grade components, this round is designed for flatter trajectories, reduced wind drift, and devastating terminal performance. - After confirming zero and studying real-world drop and wind deflection at the range, the team heads into Colorado’s rugged backcountry in pursuit of mule deer and elk. With fresh snow, steep canyons, and long shooting lanes, the terrain offers the perfect proving ground to see how the new bullet performs under pressure. - From close-range opportunities to challenging cross-canyon shots, this hunt puts the technology—and the hunters—to the test in one of the West’s toughest landscapes.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range. - Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots. - From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves. - As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field. - With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

programme.title: Italy My Love
programme.desc: In ten coastal areas of Italy, we encounter people that have a very special relationship with their region. All of them love their country, their traditions and their work. We met with enthusiasts and hedonists that permitted us to take a glimpse into their everyday lives. Young Italians, who have rediscovered nature and its treasures. Others, that preserve the beauty, archaeologists that apply whole new methods, farmers that only cultivate that which the soil needs. Fishermen, who fish in the same way as it was done a century ago and tough, young men who play and dance the Tarantella. Dolphins, giant sea turtles and pink flamingos, which are researched, nursed back to health or simply observed. Cave explorers, sail makers and coffee specialists are also part of the big picture. Flying drone cameras provide birds-eye views and are an important element of the films. The results are spectacular images from completely different angles which provide us with landscape overviews and detailed insights, the likes of which have never been seen before.

programme.title: Wild Alpine Rivers - Life in the Extreme
programme.desc: What would happen to the mountains without water? They would turn into deserts, devoid of life and vegetation. But there are very few mountains without water on our planet. They take care of this themselves, creating their life’s element and taking water directly from the sky by entrapping the clouds around them. This water then collects on the flanks of the mountains, where it turns from rivulets into rivers, that flow out into the oceans. Mountains and water are symbiotic, a cycle that keeps life on earth going. Mountain streams slowly move along meadows before, only moments later, turning into the spray of waterfalls or small mystic lakes. What kind of life can be found in and around this mysterious cosmos? We will investigate the world of the rare Danube salmon and be there to see the Danube bleak spawn. We will follow giant wels catfish into their hideouts, see great crested grebes on their underwater hunting. We go diving under the ice of frozen mountain streams and lakes, discovering life where none was thought possible.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Apes and Aliens
programme.desc: The Congo, mighty and deep like no other river - yet still a retreat and a habitat for several of our world's strangest animals. Our closest relatives live deep inside the dense jungles: three of the four giant ape species have made the Congo basin their home. Rich in extraordinary footage, the second episode of "Myths of the Congo" also presents exciting insights into one of the most mysterious and dangerous regions on earth.

programme.title: Myths of the Congo - Deep and Dangerous
programme.desc: The river that swallows all rivers - this is what the natives call it. In reality, the Congo, when considering its water masses, is the second largest and the deepest river in the world. At its source in the north of Zambia, it starts out as a mere trickle, but on its journey westwards it grows and grows, becoming ever mightier and with it, the animals, too: the shoebill stork hides in the dense papyrus. Metre-long pythons hunt for their prey in trees and huge hippos fight for power and respect in the water. To survive in the Congo, animals have to adapt to extreme conditions. Here, evolution has spawned unique creatures: fish with lungs, wings and those that go hunting on land. The Congo River feeds the second largest rainforest on earth. Here is the home of the forest elephant. Time and again, they are summoned to this one, magic place: the Dzanga Bay. Countless other forest dwellers join them. What makes this place so special?

programme.title: Wild Switzerland
programme.desc: Gentle, green meadows, rugged rock faces, mysterious lakes, dense forests, tall mountains, low-lying river deltas, quietly meandering mountain streams and smack dab in the middle, a unique fauna - THIS is Switzerland! We trace the elementary power of nature and present animals and plants in landscapes that have hardly ever been touched by mankind. Switzerland is an alpine country, but it is also Europe's surge tank. Rivers such as the Rhine and the Rhone have their sources here. Glaciers, crevasses, icy cold caves and the underwater dome of the Verzasca are the unusual settings we chose for this film. We meet with rare, selected animal species and present their behavioural patterns, such as the Swiss or Arven jay, the lynx and albino catfish. Cold, wind, snow and extreme locations demand adaptation that make us marvel.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: North Macedonia: Between Traditional Dances and Mini Navy
programme.desc: Northern Macedonia emerged from being a once constituent republic of the former Yugoslavia. Anyone wishing to discover unknown worlds has every chance of finding them in this young Balkan country, full of imposing mountains, lakes of crystal-clear water, original villages and centuries-old customs. Nevertheless, Northern Macedonia, which borders Serbia in the north and Greece in the south, considered to be one of the poorest countries in Europe.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.desc: Its native fragrant flowers and aromatic herbs have made the Provence a brand known worldwide. The wealth of flora found in this region, between the French Alps and the Mediterranean, is unequalled among the French provinces. Around Sault, near Mont Ventoux, the valleys and high plains are carpeted with bright violet: In the hot climate of the South of France, lavender blooms and exudes its fragrance. Monastic healers have been using its aromatic medicinal oil since the Middle Ages. And today an entire industry is based on the trade with this fragrant flower. Yet the livelihood of Provençal lavender farmers is imperiled. In France’s major lavender-growing region, the “Plateau de Valensole”, our viewers encounter Gérard Blanc, who has been hit particularly hard. The lavender farmer lost sixty percent of his harvest to one tiny insect: the leafhopper. This insect has already destroyed half of the lavender acreage, bumping France from its market position as the world’s top producer of lavender oil. The film visits a resolute farmer who, not about to give up, is testing methods to fend off the voracious insect.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.desc: In India, herbs play an everyday role hardly equalled anywhere in the world. From the tropical green south to the mountains of the northern Himalayas, herbs lend fragrance to joss sticks and soaps, and flavor to the cuisine. And, above all, herbs heal. Six thousand varieties of plants are used in India, and most are harvested in the wild – where they are becoming depleted. The ever rising need for herbal medicine for the subcontinent’s 1.3 billion inhabitants comes on top of the demand of its growing middle class for herbal-based cosmetics. As a result, certain herbs have become scarce, while others have already vanished entirely. Most of the herbs in India are harvested in the wild. The progress of first cultivation attempts is slow. In India, the rural population, especially, needs affordable, well-tolerated medicine – medicine based on herbs. In Kerala, the film shows a family operation that hand-produces botanical medicine for the local market. High up in the Himalayas, we observe a village healer at work. The science of Ayurvedic medicine is five thousand years old. Today, interest in the ancient healing art is surging, not only in India. In Delhi’s Old Town, the film visits a wholesaler who supplies the booming global herb market, and we take a look inside the laboratories of the largest manufacturer of Ayurvedic medicines in the world. In Kerala, we meet a doctor employed at a small Ayurveda clinic, and in Nordern India, we join a student of Tibetan medicine on a hike up into the mountains, where she prepares for an exam in herbology.

programme.title: The Secret world of Herbs
programme.desc: Healing effects, fragrance, and intense flavor – the benefits of herbs were discovered by the indigenous peoples of South America long before Spanish conquistadores subdued the continent. Even today, in the remote regions of South America, life without herbs is unthinkable. For many inhabitants, they provide the sole medicine. For more than two thousand years, this wisdom of the healing powers of nature has been passed down from generation to generation. In Bolivia, the film accompanies ethnobiologist Rainer Bussmann on one of his expeditions documenting which herbs the locals use against which illnesses. The German scientist has spent the last 15 years in the region, focussed on preserving this invaluable knowledge.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: As contrasting as the landscapes of the 15th meridian east, so different are its animal inhabitants. What are the living conditions like in the heat of the Namibian Damaraland, in Lusatia or on the coast of Norway? Which challenges do elephants, whales or kingfishers have to master together with their companions from north to south?

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: Almost 11000 kilometres lie between the northernmost and southernmost point of the 15th meridian east. Here you will find extreme landscapes such as the shimmering heat of Africa or the eternal cold of northern Scandinavia. Five people from Spitsbergen, Namibia, Slovenia, Germany and Poland dedicate their lives to environmental protection.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: This episode focuses on people from five countries who share a common passion: The production of their own food and food. What culinary treasures are hidden in the different regions, from Spitsbergen to Sweden, Austria, Poland and Chad?

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. We accompany trucker Omar and his co-driver Jaime on their trip across the Andes, encountering cyclists, mountain bikers and coca-farmers on the way.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: FernGully: The Last Rainforest
programme.desc: The magical inhabitants of a rainforest fight to save their home, which is threatened by logging and a polluting force of destruction called Hexxus.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: One Black and one white woman in 1955 Montgomery, Alabama must decide what they are going to do in response to the famous bus boycott led by Martin Luther King. Starring Whoopi Goldberg ("Ghost") and Sissy Spacek ("In the Bedroom").

programme.desc: In this crime thriller, mercenary John Seeger (Steven Seagal, "Exit Wounds") attempts to break into Eastern Europe's most impenetrable prison and free the son of a notorious drug lord.

programme.desc: An American prisoner (Dolph Lundgren, "Rocky IV") in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped American woman.

programme.title: Trespass

programme.title: Four Fast Guns
programme.desc: (1960) Western with James Craig. A former gunslinger tries to restore order to a lawless town, but is foiled by the efforts of an evil saloon owner whose infirmity grants him immunity from violence.

programme.title: Hellgate
programme.desc: (1952) Western starring Sterling Hayden. After the Civil War a rancher is wrongfully imprisoned in a notorious desert prison. When a deadly plague threatens to overwhelm the jail, can he help stop it?

programme.title: Air Rescue
programme.desc: A rescue operation is launched when a leisure helicopter carrying a young family comes down in a National Park, and a mountain hiker raises the alarm when he is injured by a giant boulder. S5Ep1

programme.title: Air Rescue
programme.desc: Air Rescue are called to locate a father and his two young sons who are trapped in an overturned fishing boat at sea, and three surfer friends are reported missing in challenging conditions. S5Ep2

programme.title: Amber Alert
programme.desc: A troubled young man hijacks a bus load of school children. Meanwhile Detective Amber Cross (Alaina Huffman), battling with her own demons and issues, is called in to negotiate

programme.title: Ex-Wife Killer
programme.desc: A woman vouches for her ex-husband after he seemingly kills his new wife in self-defence but after he is let off the hook, she discovers his elaborate ploy. Starring Marguerite Moreau (2017)

programme.title: The Daughter Stalker
programme.desc: (2020) Twist-laden thriller with Karynn Moore. When her wealthy estranged sister dies, Carly is shocked to be named guardian of her daughter. But someone's plans didn't include a long-lost relative...

programme.title: A Teacher's Obsession
programme.desc: (2015) Obsessive drama with Mia Rose Frampton. A troubled high school student meets a teacher who offers to help her avoid probation, but her methods prove unethical, disturbing and ultimately deadly.

programme.title: A Teacher's Obsession
programme.desc: (2015) Obsessive drama with Mia Rose Frampton. A troubled high school student meets a teacher who offers to help her avoid probation, but her methods prove unethical, disturbing and ultimately deadly.

programme.title: Nanny Beware
programme.desc: (2023) Thriller starring Lesa Wilson. A nanny's dream job turns into a nightmare when she discovers the child in her care was kidnapped - and his 'parents' will do anything to keep the truth buried.

programme.title: Fatal Justice
programme.desc: (2012) Crime thriller with Cynthia Watros. After a robbery leaves her beloved niece in a coma and the cops have no leads, a woman goes from victim to vigilante and takes matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Trigger Point
programme.desc: (2015) Thriller starring Jordan Hinson. After her father is laid off, a passionate college student joins activists to stop a corporation from ruining more lives.

programme.title: Firequake
programme.desc: (2014) Sci-fi action with Alexandra Paul, Zoe Barker and Nigel Barber. When a new, highly explosive energy source seeps into the Earth's crust, can its creator save humanity from being extinguished?

programme.title: Super Collider
programme.desc: The world's largest particle collider malfunctions and opens a portal to a nightmare dimension.

programme.title: Stonados
programme.desc: (2013) Schlocky disaster flick starring Paul Johansson. When tornadoes start tossing boulders at Boston, a storm chaser must stop the ensuing chaos using his untested theory on weather manipulation.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: (1958) Western starring Alan Ladd. A soldier returns home after the Civil War to find his wife dead and his son shocked into silence. He rides out, determined to find both a cure and justice.

programme.title: Johnson County War - Part 1
programme.desc: (2002) Contemporary western with Tom Berenger, Luke Perry and Burt Reynolds. Three brothers are pulled into a fiery conflict between old cowboys and new homesteaders. (1/2)

programme.title: Death Rides a Horse
programme.desc: (1967) Brutal western with Lee Van Cleef and John Phillip Law. Fifteen years after his family were massacred by bandits, a young boy is now a skilled gunslinger - and he's hell-bent on revenge...

programme.title: Ride in The Whirlwind
programme.desc: (1966) Western starring Jack Nicholson. Mistaken for outlaws, three cowboys find themselves on the run from a relentless posse hungry for justice.

programme.title: Off The Rails
programme.desc: (2017) Thriller starring Hannah Barefoot. After surviving a train wreck, a married woman loses her memory. As the pieces of her old life start to come together, will the truth tear her apart?

programme.title: Staged Killer
programme.desc: When a former co-host works his way back into the life of popular TV host Naomi Spencer, the show's success skyrockets, but Naomi's personal life begins to fall apart. Starring Chrishell Stause (2019)

programme.title: Stealing Paradise
programme.desc: (2011) Thriller starring Rachael Leigh Cook. A brilliant engineer's design is stolen and patented by her colleague. When he's found murdered, she becomes the prime suspect and must fight for her life.

programme.title: Lost and Found
programme.desc: (2019) Thriller with Samaire Armstrong. A teenage girl returns home years after disappearing, but joy is short lived when suspicious character start following her every move.

programme.title: Second Chances
programme.desc: After wrongly supporting a man who later turned out to be a serial killer, journalist Kate Fisher rebuilds her career but is stalked by someone from her past. Melissa George stars. (2010)

programme.title: Killer Ending
programme.desc: (2018) Drama thriller starring Chelsea Hobbs. Crime fiction becomes a horrifying reality when a novelist's daughter is abducted in a copycat scenario taken straight from her latest book.

programme.title: Turbulence
programme.desc: (2016) High-flying action with Dina Meyer, Victoria Pratt and Justin Johnson Cortez. An FBI agent's flight is about to get bumpy as her mysterious seat mate forces her to make a life-or-death choice.

programme.title: Super Eruption
programme.desc: (2011) Explosive sci-fi with Richard Burgi. When the dormant supervolcano under Yellowstone National Park erupts, millions of lives are at risk. Can Rangers Charlie and Kate save the day?

programme.title: Jack Hunter And The Lost Treasure Of Ugarit
programme.desc: An adventuring archaeologist navigates danger and conspiracy to try and find the fabled treasure of the Ugarit. Starring Ivan Sergei (2008).

programme.title: Meteor Storm
programme.desc: (2010) Sci-fi action adventure starring Kari Matchett. An astronomer works to save the city of San Francisco from total annihilation when a once-in-a-lifetime celestial event turns into a nightmare.

programme.title: Air Rescue
programme.desc: A rescue crew fly to the remote Babel Island to help a man who is suffering from chest pains, and an out-of-control car pins a grandmother to a wall, crushing her foot and pelvis. S5Ep3

programme.title: Kentucky Rifle
programme.desc: (1955) Suspenseful western with Chill Wills, Lance Fuller and Cathy Downs. When a gun-filled wagon breaks down in enemy territory, will its occupants surrender their cargo or fight for their lives?

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: (1955) Classic western with Randolph Scott and Forrest Tucker. When the notorious Reno Brothers start rampaging through the west, a special agent is sent to bring them to justice.

programme.title: A Reason To Live, A Reason To Die
programme.desc: (1972) Western with James Coburn and Telly Savalas. Branded a coward for surrendering his fort to the Confederates, a Union colonel recruits seven condemned men for a daring mission to recapture it.

programme.title: Angel and the Badman
programme.desc: (1947) Western with the legendary John Wayne. A wounded gunslinger is taken in by a Quaker girl, who inspires him to give up his old ways - until his past catches up with him and puts her in danger.

programme.title: Air Rescue
programme.desc: A Gold Coast holidaymaker is caught in a deadly ocean rip current, a skydiver is airlifted to hospital, and a groom-to-be is left gripping to the side of a mountain with a suspected broken leg. S5Ep4

programme.title: Air Rescue
programme.desc: An injured man clings to the rocks after falling into the ocean, and a head-on car collision leaves two tourists fighting for their lives. S5Ep5

programme.title: Dispatch
programme.desc: (2016) Crime thriller with Fiona Gubelmann. A 911 operator takes a call from a child and dismisses it as a prank. But when a body is discovered, she'll do whatever it takes to make things right...

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: The Missing Sister
programme.desc: When Sharon tracks down her estranged sister she's elated to reunite—until she suspects that it's an impostor.

programme.title: The Perfect Soulmate
programme.desc: A poet with an abusive husband reaches out to a fan for help, only to find an even more dangerous companion.

programme.title: Maria My Love
programme.desc: A young woman named Ana is struggling to deal with her mother's death and her father's mistakes. In an effort to feel better, she reconnects with her half-sister Grace, (Lauren Fales) and, inspired by a new boyfriend (Brian Rieger), sets out on a quest to find someone to help. Though excited and hopeful when she meets an eccentric woman named Maria (Karen Black), she soon discovers Maria is a compulsive hoarder, and is swept up in a situation more emotionally and morally complicated than she had expected to find. Inspired by a true story.

programme.title: The Wrong Patient
programme.desc: Dr. Richards, a successful plastic surgeon, is caught in a narcissistic patient's scary quest for perfection.

programme.title: Alter
programme.desc: Alter, a psychological thriller about a man who is convinced that he’s found his childhood abductor, and is determined to get him to confess by any means necessary.

programme.title: Dying for a Baby
programme.desc: A couple is threatened when Jessica, the driver from their past accident, moves in next door seeking revenge.

programme.title: The Past Never Dies
programme.desc: CASEY MARSH was born in captivity. Her mother, JANE, was abducted as a teenager and gave birth to Casey while she was being held by the kidnapper, TIMOTHY FAST. Jane eventually escaped when Casey was 6 years old. Timothy Fast was arrested and incarcerated. Ever since, Jane has struggled to regain a normal life for her and her daughter. For Casey, the memories of a childhood in captivity still haunt her. Jane, on the other hand, has seemingly moved on. She has re-married and is happy. When a number of local women start to go missing, Jane reveals to Casey that Timothy might have had an accomplice and wonders if he is involved. The kidnapping M.O. is eerily similar.
